# Loader { #timetoalign.loader.Loader }

```python
loader.Loader()
```

Shared lifecycle for all loader families.

The root owns source tracking, the ``load`` template, convenience
construction, and timeline-creation surfaces. Payload-specific state and
APIs belong to subclasses such as :class:`EventLoader`,
:class:`ManifestLoader`, and :class:`AlignmentLoader`.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [metadata](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.metadata) | Aggregated source metadata. |
| [sources](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.sources) | List of loaded source paths. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.clear) | Clear shared source state. |
| [create_bundle](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_bundle) | Create an alignment bundle when supported. |
| [create_group](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_group) | Create a timeline group when supported. |
| [create_timeline](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timeline) | Create a timeline from the loaded payload. |
| [create_timelines](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timelines) | Create all timelines, optionally filtered by an implementation. |
| [from_file](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.from_file) | Instantiate the loader, load *paths*, and return it. |
| [load](#timetoalign.loader.Loader.load) | Load and accept one or more sources through the shared template. |

### clear { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.clear }

```python
loader.Loader.clear()
```

Clear shared source state.

### create_bundle { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_bundle }

```python
loader.Loader.create_bundle(**kwargs)
```

Create an alignment bundle when supported.

### create_group { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_group }

```python
loader.Loader.create_group(**kwargs)
```

Create a timeline group when supported.

### create_timeline { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timeline }

```python
loader.Loader.create_timeline(uid=None, **kwargs)
```

Create a timeline from the loaded payload.

Concrete loader families implement payload-specific construction.

### create_timelines { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.create_timelines }

```python
loader.Loader.create_timelines(id_pattern=None)
```

Create all timelines, optionally filtered by an implementation.

### from_file { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.from_file }

```python
loader.Loader.from_file(*paths, **kwargs)
```

Instantiate the loader, load *paths*, and return it.

### load { #timetoalign.loader.Loader.load }

```python
loader.Loader.load(*sources)
```

Load and accept one or more sources through the shared template.
